notes.title: v1.047 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
v1.047 is just some boring fixes to minor issues, and some attempts to make older controllers work more reliably.

FIXED: an issue where doing a big kick at the instant a pop-up popped up in the Training caused a mishap
FIXED: a misspelling of the word FOOTBALL which I mean how did I even
FIXED: an issue where Goldkeepers could get sent off for being offside which, I mean, I don't know the rules but that doesn't "feel" like it's right?
FIXED: an issue with Pause Screen buttons interferring with Tutorial pop-up boxes.
ADDED: an extra double-triple failsafe for the ball getting stuck out of bounds because, despite the fact the code is rock solid on that, somehow some of you have still somehow managed it
ADDED: Custom Controller map for Xbox360 pad users, in the hopes of solving a connection issue
ADDED: Right Stick customisation to the Options->Input screen, in the hopes of solving some PS3 controller sensitivity issues

FIXED?: Added custom controls for those of you using a PS3/ PS4 controller, in the hopes it fixes the Right Stick lack of sensitivity issue
FIXED?: Occasional Mac crash bug caused by OSX failing to load a Library because [TODO: make up some clever tech terminology here? I honestly have no idea]

notes.title: v1.046 Now Live! Just some minor bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Hello! Me again, sorry. Just popping v1.046 live for you, with some fixes and some fixes?

Thanks again for all your support so far, I'm utterly delighted to see so many people having so much fun with this. Please keep recommending it, keep streaming it, keep talking about it. Your engagement is like gold to me, so please keep it up.

As always, if there's anything awry you've spotted, the best way to let me know is dan@sizefivegames.com, because it's easy to miss stuff when it's just tweeted or left as a comment somewhere!

[if this patch breaks something I'm not aware of, you can opt into the Beta build which is now 1.044 which was the last version. Right click the game in your Library-> Properties->Betas passcode is thekickmenbeta.]

FIXED: some sutpid typos that were pointed out to me by someone for who(m?) English is their SECOND LANGUAGE and I found that quite embarrassing
FIXED: an issue where if you were charging a tackle as a whistle blew, it could get locked in charge state
FIXED: Promotion/ Demotion text no longer displays if you draw a match after being promoted/ demoted
FIXED: prevented game from losing focus when using mouse controls
FIXED: an issue that was making Goldkeepers in QuickPlay slightly more inept than they should be

FIXED?: Made a 2nd attempt at stopping some gfx cards playing menus at like 40,000fps and having a bit of a meltdown. I can't replicate this issue here, so let me know if it's still busted?
FIXED?: 4:3 safety now safer than ever. Let me know if anything else is still hanging over the edge of the screen?

notes.title: Hello, Thank You, and Update Details (v1.044)
notes.notes:
Hello! I want to say a HUGE thank you to everyone who's bought a copy of Behold the Kickmen so far, I hope you're all enjoying it as much as is possible given that it's a football game.

Also, thanks so much to all of you who have left a review - we're currently at Very Positive which is just amazingly heartening to see, so if you've taken the time to do that, please know it has made me extremely happy.

Obviously as soon as the game got into more hands than I could possibly have Beta Tested it on, a few issues cropped up. These have all now been patched, bar one (see below). You can see the version number of your build down the bottom right of the Title Screen.

I will continue to address issues as soon as they come in. My Twitter's a bit full-on at the moment, so please email dan@sizefivegames.com if you come across a problem so it doesn't get lost.

You're now at v1.044
FIXED: Occasional bug where an enemy player could stand around waiting to take a penalty until the heat death of the Universe.
FIXED:Slide tackling the enemy in the Tutorial causing a great big whoopsie and making everything go awry
FIXED: Input setup screen showing DashRight twice, and DashLeft never. Quite how I missed that is beyond me
FIXED: A couple of rogue sound effects rudely not obeying the sound volume slider
FIXED: Red Card achievement not popping up it you walloped a fella three times
FIXED:: the tutorial suggesting you press the Kick button to do a Tackle
FIXED:an issue where, with *dogged* determination you could set your 442 to have players start on the wrong side of the pitch, 
which is CLEARLY cheating and if you did this you should feel a deep shame
FIXED: misspelled "World Cup" in the Achievements. I mean honestly
REFUSED TO FIX: the spelling mistak on the 1st splash screen because come on that's obviously a joke

KNOWN, BUT HELP? someone mentioned that hitting a Goldkeeper made the game fail to restart after the penalty. I've been completely unable to recreate this, and I can't find the tweet because it was 1st thing this morning and it's scrolled down the list into oblivion. So if this was you, or if you see this happen, please email me dan@sizefivegames.com with exactly what happened so I can fix it? Thank you!
